name: Palace
tagline: Also known as Shithead. Get rid of every card — don't be the last one holding them.
rulesSummary: Everyone gets three cards face down on the table, three face up on top of them, and three in hand. The rest is the draw pile.
Before play, swap any hand cards with your face-up cards (strong cards are good to keep face up). Whoever shows the lowest card starts.
Play a card, or several of one rank, equal to or higher than the top of the pile, then draw back up to three. Aces are high.
Can't or won't play? Pick up the whole pile.
A 2 goes on anything, and anything goes on a 2. A 10 goes on anything and burns the pile, as does four of a kind on top — then play again.
With your hand gone and the draw pile empty, play your face-up cards, then turn the face-down ones over one at a time. If it doesn't go, pick it up with the pile.
Go out by playing your last card. The last player left holding cards is the Shithead — and deals next.
